snippet.title: Amphibian - World Premiere Announcement Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
A countrywide drought forces Sapo and his frog allies into war against the invading toads. As dehydration and starvation grip the pond, they must hurry to find a solution to the crisis - and liberate their homeland.

Music by: Western Education
